prompt: Locked-off tripod shot, the camera does not move. A quiet empty dental clinic reception at night. Distant city lights twinkle gently and a few far windows switch softly on and off. Thin night haze drifts slowly past the moon. On the reception desk, the smartphone screen glows a little brighter with a soft blue light, as if a message arrived, then settles back. Everything else stays perfectly still. No people, no text. Calm, slow, cinematic, seamless loop.
